blocks.text: ANKARA, Turkey—A Turkish homeless man admitted to intentionally committing the offense of insulting President Recep Tayyip Erdogan in order to gain access to food and a bed in jail, media reports said Friday. The 66-year-old was detained for the offense in a park in the southern resort town of Alanya, near the city of Antalya. “I have nowhere to stay. I sleep in garbage dumps. That is why I did it,” he told a court, which jailed him pending trial for the offense, according to the newspaper Sozcu.
